arms.R1: frozen IF-01 A2 with verification against IF-02 S
arms.G: IF-02 cached 4x4 groups with open group count
arms.F: point-support groups with open group count and no spatial grouping or per-cell eligibility

inputs: same 15 clips/800 samples and original R1 parent references. Exact original SIFT, gray cache, geometry verification, sharpness>=8, HSV<=0.5, direct nonself matches. Same query-frame availability mask for G/F. No reactivated alternative or new reference. Verify v08 detector fingerprints and reciprocal IDs; recover missing full pairs only via frozen v07 full_pair and verify old metadata/prefix. Quarantine mismatch.
G: Use IF-02 exact region complete-link clusters: at least two common 0.8s bins and window Jaccard>=.60. Same-view two-region/original .25 raw qualification. Remove exactly-two restriction. Original eligible clusters enter open-group screening; previously ineligible atoms compatible with all eligible clusters can be shared as in IF-02. No finer grids.
F: For each original reference separately, one atom per original 1px dedup site with linked actual keypoint IDs. Per verified pair count each reference and query site once in ascending keypoint ID order. A site needs >=2 distinct 0.8s bins of nonself positive support. Cap 128 eligible sites per reference using round robin across exact positive window profiles, ordered by descending bin count and stable keypoint ID. Complete-link with the same two common bins and Jaccard>=.60. No image region, spatial adjacency or coordinates used in grouping beyond original 1px identity dedup. Each candidate cluster requires >=4 stable sites; query requires >=3 directly matched sites and original .25 raw fraction. Same frozen peeling code used by projecting each point's presence onto valid view frames meeting both limits, retaining unprojected observation rows. No spatial minimum. Never equate cross-reference IDs. Per ref exploration preserves original two-reference/parent limit, each F child has a single directly witnessed reference.
open_screen: All individually qualified groups are screened simultaneously. A child needs >=2 exclusive positive samples in >=2 different bins against the union of all other qualified groups; exclude cross-group near-duplicates (HSV<=.04 and gray MAD<=.02). Rank by exclusive bins then stable cluster ID, accept only if Jaccard<=.50 with each previously accepted group's positive windows. Remaining groups retained as diagnostics (including narrow or ambiguous third groups), not presumed transitions. At least two independently accepted children replace the parent; otherwise use original parent explicitly even in F. Observed exclusive support is not negative evidence.
budget: Each arm max 6 active identities, original max2 refs/ID, G max8 regions/view, F max128 dedup sites/ref, log all original/core and budget-excluded structures. Deterministic priority by second-highest qualifying exclusive-bin count then parent ID. With spare capacity keep ranked prefix of >=2 children; if none, preserve parent. No parent/child simultaneous vote, original parent logged verbatim for rollback. No promotion.
competition: Reuse exact old refine_features, 0.12 win margin, both original peeling rounds and v06/v05 downstream. F remaps feature units and presence as described; G versus F compares complete representations/readout, not a one-parameter causal assertion. Record all direct-positive contenders, dual support, scores and after-peeling outcomes, no label overrides.
evaluation: Run G and F on all 15 even if no proposal. Open labels only after both complete. Common exclusion union of old v05 prototypes and IF-01/current refs. Endpoint labels only for post-run analysis. Compare first chronological transition only; null where unavailable. Same V/uniform and 8 native images. Each of room_corridor_dev, dissolve, 16455680 read fresh video in G and F at 10fps, first automatic coarse bracket +/-0.5 or middle third. Report known-development limits.
stop: One frozen G/F pass. No new detector, tuning sweep, negative inference, paid calls, or autonomous Agent evaluation.
